description: Two stimuli colocated in RF; attend nonpreferred (attended-away preferred) vs attend away, preferred contrast swept. Two solid CRFs are CLEARLY SEPARATED with a visible white gap through the whole rising portion (re-traced separately per curve at ~6-8x zoom). The upper (attended) solid sits above the lower (unattended) solid by ~0.10 at mid-contrast, narrowing to ~0.04 near the top. The pair merges only in the low-contrast toe (x<~0.025). Attended saturates ~0.80, unattended ~0.77 of left-axis full scale (NOT 1.0). Dashed percent-modulation (right axis 0-100) peaks ~36% at low contrast and declines monotonically to a few % at high contrast.

provenance.figure_type: line/curve attentional CRF pair (two solids) + declining %-modulation dashed on right axis, log-x
provenance.tool_rationale: Mode-1 quantitative plot. Two same-color solid CRFs that are visibly separated for most of the range -> traced SEPARATELY, each in its own row-band (upper band = attended, lower band = unattended), splitting wherever the white gap is resolvable (down to x~0.025) and treating them as a merged envelope only in the deep toe. Dashed isolated by its own region/gaps and right-axis calibration. PCHIP for rounded saturation/flat toe.

calibration.plot_box_note: detect_plot_box auto-returned left=12, which is the leftover right edge of adjacent panel B; true left frame is col 50 (verified by longest-dark-run scan). Top/bottom/right verified by horizontal long-run scan within frame columns.

per_curve.attended: traced as the UPPER solid in its own band, separated from unattended wherever the white gap resolves (x>=~0.025); deep toe (x<~0.025) merges into the envelope with the unattended curve.
per_curve.unattended: traced as the LOWER solid in its own band; well-resolved across the rising portion and plateau.
per_curve.percent_modulation: dashed, isolated by region and right-axis calibration; monotone decline, no rising-solid crossover wobble (the prior x~0.11-0.15 bump was removed by tracing the dashed in its own band).

provenance.normalization: paper shared sub-1.0 left scale; attended saturates ~0.80, unattended ~0.77 at top contrast (NOT pinned to 1.0).

gap_record.note: gap ~0.10 mid-contrast narrowing to ~0.04 at high contrast; matches the independent critic trace (0.101@0.23, 0.068@0.54, 0.042@0.84). This CORRECTS the prior digitization which collapsed the gap to ~0.01-0.03 (3-5x understated) and placed the attended plateau ~0.04-0.05 low (0.748).

caveats: No numeric x ticks on the panel; x_range [0.01,1.0] log is taken from the model sweep range / panel .md (same assumption as the prior digitization and the critic; relative gap is independent of it).
Left y-max=1.0 assumed at the top frame (row 13), consistent with the right axis 0-100 mapping over the same span; no explicit left-axis numeric tick beyond the implied 0..1.
Two solids merge in the deep toe (x<~0.025); the split there is set to 0 (envelope), not an invented gap.
Curves were re-traced only to col 176 (x~0.93, the rightmost dark pixels); values at x=1.0 are a mild PCHIP continuation of the still-rising CRF, not a flat plateau.
